verdict.rationale: Gemini documents persistent instructions, but each is scoped. Custom Gems let you set requirements for that Gem. Notebooks remember your sources and instructions within that notebook. Personalization draws on memory of past chats. None of the evidence shows a global custom-instructions setting that shapes every response across all chats. Missing for 10: a documented account-wide custom instructions/preferences setting, details on how stored preferences are edited and applied to every response, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response

citations.quote: To create a custom Gem to meet your goals, provide info about your request and requirements.
Notebooks provide a continuous chat experience that remembers your sources, instructions, and ongoing discussions.
You can get a personalized experience in Gemini Apps based on: The memory of your past Gemini chats
